# The Emerald Knights

Knights of [The Emerald Lights](/cast/the_emerald_lights.qmd)

## The Violet Knight

Leader of Fabriknock, an Emerald Light strong hold.

<center>
![The Violet Knight](/images/violet_knight_dither.png){style="width:250px; border-radius: 5px;"}
</center>

- 5-4
- The Obsidian
- Ruler of [Fabriknock](/holdings/fabriknock.qmd) (he/him)
- Young
- Was part of the Original company of knights (player knights)
- Flattering handmirror: Show's the viewer the ideal vision of themselves

They are adored by the emerald lights and they adore them back.

They became the leader of Fabriknock by winning a duel against the previous leader, [The Leaf Knight](/cast/other_holding_knights.qmd#the-leaf-knight).
This was during [The Terminator](/history/second_age.qmd#the-terminator) event.



### Stats

VIG: 12, CLA: 7, SPI 10

GD: 9, Armor: 2

- Grand mace (d10, long)
- Dagger (d6)
- Shortsword (d6)
- Wicker gambeson (A1)
- Wicker beekeeper helmet (A1)

Ability: Metal object you hold emits ultraviolet light. You can see this light.

## The Cosmic Knight

- 5-5
- The Emerald
- Was [Mentha the Mint](/cast/the_emerald_lights.qmd#mentha-the-mint)

### Stats

VIG: 15, CLA: 14, SPI 13

GD: 4

- Strange crossbow: lightwood (d8 hefty), Cannot shoot in the dark
- Echostone (can record and repeat one spoken phrase)
- Boneless steed (VIG 10, CLA 8, SPI 5, 3 GD, can squeeze through any gap as large as its head)

Ability: If they can see the skies they can focus for a minute and vanish to a distant sanctuary beyond reality. Leave a small glowing stone that you can rematerilise at at any time.

## The Forge Knight

- 3-12
- The Yellow
- Religious leader of [Fabriknock](/holdings/fabriknock.qmd) (he/him)
- Was [Crabbe](/cast/the_emerald_lights.qmd#crabbe)

### Stats

VIG: 8, CLA: 11, SPI 12

GD: 2, Armor: 2

- Bolt-guisarme (d10 long in melee or d10 slow ranged)
- Gambeson (A1)
- Scale (A1)
- Scars from the forge: Branded arm, Light sensitivity
- Pots of forge dust (spreads irritating gas in the area when broken, Impairing attacks from within. You can make more anywhere with a forge)
- Helmed steed (VIG 14, CLA 4, SPI 5, 4GD, d6 trample, A1)

Ability: Your weapon deals +d8 until the end of combat after causing a wound

Passion: Restore SPI when wounded by fire

## The Reliquary Knight

- 5-10
- The Fourth

### Stats

VIG: 13, CLA: 12, SPI 10

GD: 2, Armor: 2

- War sickle (d8 hefty)
- Gambeson (A1)
- Carved plate (A1)
- Sack of history tomes
- Treasured reliquary (Dessicated pinky of the Green Eyed Seer)
- Bearded steed (VIG 12, CLA 8, SPI 6, 3GD)

Ability: Once per day, release the invisible spirit from reliquary. 
In essence an invisible Mr Meeseeks.

Passion: tradition is thoroughly honoured.
